title: Fabulous Flamenco Show in Triana
text:
If you are looking for a truly unforgettable flamenco show, in the Triana district,  look no further.  

The show consisted of two dancers, a singer and a guitar player. All performers gave their all and gelled together beautifully.  We were treated to stunning flamenco dancing and superb guitar playing, both of which took our breath away at times!

From start to finish, the whole experience was amazing and one we will never forget!
author: Stevesue2

title: Great show!
text: We enjoyed this flamenco show. Great dancers, the guitarist was super and the singer Raul very talented. Incomprehensible that the three of us were the only ones in the theatre. Despite the poor attendance, all four were passionate and put on a whirlwind show for an hour! Highly recommended!
author: Eddy B
